verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships AI features (Amplitude AI, an embeddable agent), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence only documents Amplitude's own MCP server, which exposes Amplitude data to tools like Claude and Cursor. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. Its integrations directory covers data and marketing connectors, not MCP, so nothing shows it can consume third-party MCP servers.
